# BotForge

> BotForge builds Telegram bots with AI. Describe a bot in plain words; BotForge generates its commands and replies, connects your BotFather token, and hosts it live.

## Pages
- [Home](/): features, templates, pricing and FAQ
- [UI blocks](/components): showcase of BotForge page blocks
- [Privacy Policy](/privacy)
- [Terms of Service](/terms)

## Templates
File converter, AI chat, group moderation, welcome bot, URL shortener, QR generator, reminders, quiz.
